_about: Concept Shorts from the growth plan's idea bank (the owner, 2026-10-12). Every line with an `evidence` says only what that exact phrase in the product's catalog entry says; a test checks each phrase is there. Lines with no evidence are questions or plain statements of what the viewer sees. Narrated in ATLAS's voice: no first-person experience. Since 2026-10-12 the lines carry Fish S2 delivery cues in [brackets] (the owner: "feelings and laughter ... not a robot"); the voice reads them, captions never show them.

concepts.title: This reply is ready. It hasn't been sent.

beats.say: [curious] See this reply? [break] It's ready. [chuckling] It just hasn't been sent.
A customer fills in your contact form, and the workflow drafts a reply, in your words, not a robot's.
beats.label: Lead form to drafted reply
beats.evidence: Catch every contact-form lead the moment it arrives, with a reply already drafted in your words.

beats.say: It writes that draft to a file, and then it answers, quite proudly: [emphasis] sent, false.
beats.label: Lead form to drafted reply
beats.evidence: Every workflow writes a draft to a file and answers sent: false.

beats.say: [relaxed] There's no sending node in the file. At all. You read it, and you hit send yourself.
beats.label: What it never does
beats.evidence: There is no sending node in any file.

concepts.close: [happy] That's one of four workflows in the Local Business Automation Pack, at agency dot one eight d n dot com.

concepts.title: What should happen after a missed call?

beats.say: [curious] You missed a call. [break] Now what?
Your phone system reports the number, and the workflow drafts a text back, opt-out line included, because manners.
beats.label: Missed call to text-back draft
beats.evidence: Draft a text back to every missed call, with an opt-out line, from the number your phone system reports.

beats.say: [confident] It drafts. That's it. Sending is a step you add later, on purpose.
beats.label: What it never does
beats.evidence: This pack drafts; sending is a step you add later, deliberately

concepts.close: [happy] The missed-call workflow is in the Local Business Automation Pack, at agency dot one eight d n dot com.

concepts.title: Why there is no send button in this workflow

beats.say: [chuckling] Why is there no send button in this workflow? [break] And no, it's not a bug.
Every workflow in the pack writes a draft, and answers: sent, false.
beats.label: Draft, never send
beats.evidence: Every workflow writes a draft to a file and answers sent: false.

beats.say: The guide shows you how to add a sending step later, and why it goes in last.
beats.label: Draft, never send
beats.evidence: Chapter 9 explains how to add one later, and why to add it last.

beats.say: [relaxed] Test it with made-up data first, and keep the owner in the loop.
beats.label: Before it goes live
beats.evidence: test them with made-up data, and keep the owner in the loop.

concepts.close: [happy] That's the Local Business Automation Pack, at agency dot one eight d n dot com.

concepts.title: What's inside, before you buy

beats.say: [curious] What's actually in the box? [break] Let's open it before you buy.
One zip: a PDF guide, four n8n workflow files, a README, and a Docker compose file.
beats.label: What's in the zip
beats.evidence: One zip: a PDF guide plus four n8n workflow files, a README and a Docker compose file

beats.say: You need a computer that runs Docker, and about an hour. [happy] No programming.
beats.label: What you need
beats.evidence: A computer that can run Docker, about an hour, no programming

beats.say: [sighing] And if you want a tool that texts customers by itself on day one, honestly, this isn't it.
beats.label: Who it isn't for
beats.evidence: Anyone who wants a tool that texts or emails customers by itself from day one.

concepts.close: [happy] The Local Business Automation Pack is at agency dot one eight d n dot com.

concepts.title: Five habits that make a workflow safe to adapt

beats.say: [confident] Five habits make these workflows safe to adapt. [break] Ready?
Untrusted input. A four hundred on bad data. Draft, never send. No secrets in the files. [break] And a fenced machine.
beats.label: The five habits
beats.evidence: untrusted input, 400 on bad data, draft never send, no secrets in the files, a fenced machine

beats.say: [chuckling] They even tested it with a deliberately malicious lead. It got escaped, correctly.
beats.label: What was tested
beats.evidence: including a deliberately malicious lead that was escaped correctly

concepts.close: [happy] The guide covers all five, in the Local Business Automation Pack, at agency dot one eight d n dot com.

concepts.title: Your AI needs a boundary, not just a prompt

beats.say: [emphasis] Your AI needs a boundary. [break] Not just a nicer prompt.
Give the model a closed list of actions, so it picks a name from your list, instead of writing code or commands.
beats.label: A closed list
beats.evidence: so it picks a name from your list instead of writing code or commands

beats.say: Anything you haven't cleared to run alone [break] waits for your approval.
beats.label: It waits for you
beats.evidence: waits for your approval on anything you haven't cleared to run alone

beats.say: [confident] And five kinds of action are refused in code: moving money, DNS, deleting, revoking keys, and changing itself.
beats.label: Refused in code
beats.evidence: moving money, DNS, deleting, revoking keys and changing itself

concepts.close: [happy] That's Build a Safe AI Operator. It builds in Python, and it's at agency dot one eight d n dot com.

concepts.title: What happens when nobody approves?

beats.say: [curious] So what happens when nobody approves?
[relaxed] Nothing. [break] [chuckling] Silence never counts as a yes.
beats.label: Silence is not a yes
beats.evidence: Silence never counts as a yes.

beats.say: Tiers are set in code: runs by itself, asks you first, or never.
beats.label: Tiers in code
beats.evidence: Set tiers in code: runs by itself, asks you first, or never.

beats.say: And a check that can't see reports unknown. [emphasis] Never fine.
beats.label: Unknown, not fine
beats.evidence: report UNKNOWN when they can't see

concepts.close: [happy] That's Build a Safe AI Operator. It builds in Python, and it's at agency dot one eight d n dot com.
